name: cleanroom_r2e_top2000_shortlist_reranker_v1
purpose: Test whether a train-only pair residual reranker can convert frozen RDKit+ coarse full-universe headroom into improved Top-K retrieval without exposing cold dev/outer entities during training.
development_benchmarks: clean2023 internal strict protein+reaction entity-disjoint folds 0/1/2 only
coarse_retriever: frozen rdkitplus_augmented fold-specific cleanroom checkpoint; no coarse parameters updated by reranker
selection_rule: smallest audited shortlist N whose mean coarse Hit@N across internal reaction-similarity <0.3 folds is >=0.50
training_exposure_policy: for each internal fold, coarse hard-negative mining is restricted to entities appearing in that fold training pairs; held-out dev proteins are never mined or scored as training negatives
training_examples: all labelled train positives plus fixed-size samples drawn only from each train query coarse Top-2000 non-positive hard candidates; no dev labels or dev candidates in fitting
evaluation_policy: rerank only frozen full-universe coarse Top-2000; candidates outside Top-2000 preserve their coarse relative order; exact deterministic full ranks are reconstructed for all labelled positives
promotion_rule: must improve the predeclared joint metric summary over frozen coarse on internal folds without a material regression in the complementary broad metrics; Hit@10 alone is insufficient
outer_policy: no outer reranker evaluation until architecture/training recipe is frozen from internal folds; outer labels cannot alter shortlist size or fitting recipe
